biography.plain_text: John Risley is a Canadian entrepreneur who co-founded Clearwater Seafoods with Colin MacDonald in Nova Scotia. He built his fortune in shellfish harvesting, processing and export, before expanding into nutrition, telecommunications and private investment. His business interests have included Ocean Nutrition Canada, Columbus Communications and the investment holding company CFFI Ventures.

confidence.reason: Primary ownership and business records corroborate the founder-built seafood core and historically phrased diversification.

long_biography.plain_text:
Seafood entrepreneur John Risley sought customers beyond the American market that Canadian fishers knew best. He promoted lobster sales in Europe beyond the Christmas season, then worked to persuade Chinese buyers and restaurants to choose the Canadian product. Buying fishing licences from smaller operators helped Clearwater secure supplies as its export business grew.

When the owners decided to sell, Risley wanted a buyer prepared to keep the company for the long term. A coalition of Mi'kmaq communities partnered with Premium Brands to acquire it. He supported keeping professional management and reinvesting in the business, while treating Indigenous participation as an ownership partnership.
